WHAT WE MEASURE OURSELVES · EACH READING ON ITS OWN
There is no single Scintilla fear & greed number here any more. We hold 364 stocks, no options flow of our own and no exchange high/low counts, so an internal one-number index would be claiming to measure a market we cannot see. Every row below is a real measurement of a real thing, with its own source and its own age, and nothing is averaged into a headline.

Each row is scored the way CNN scores its own: how far today sits from that input’s own average, measured in the size it normally moves — two of those steps either way is the end of the dial; volatility and put/call are inverted, because more fear belongs at the low end. The cnn column is CNN’s own component score, for comparison only.

IS THE X FEED CURRENT?
Newest post in the published feed: 2026-09-23 22:30Z · 1h ago — within the collector's two-hour rhythm.
17351 posts are stored in that feed in total; 1070 of them fall in the last 24 hours and 431 carried a word the list knows. The collector runs on Alan’s MacBook at 06:30, 08:30, 10:30, 12:30, 14:30, 16:30, 18:30, 21:00 and 23:30 ET and publishes the whole feed each time; this page only ever reads what it published.
HOW EACH VOICE IS MEASURED
YouTube. A scheduled job collects clips from the channels Alan subscribes to and from ticker searches, and files them in youtube_videos. For the subscribed channels it fetches the English transcript and counts finance keywords around each ticker mention — a word list with negation (yt-lexicon-v1), not an AI read — and writes one pooled row per ticker into social_sentiment over a 7-day window.
